{{Term/Store|Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor|Series, BotW|plural}} are [[Item]]s in {{BotW}}.{{Name Ref|BotW}}

==Location and Uses==
After defeating [[Calamity Ganon]], [[Link]] can visit [[Kilton]] to receive a Medal of Honor, one for each type of overworld boss.<ref>{{Cite|You've done it! You've defeated all the {{Color BotW|Blue|Moldugas}}! [...] Oh, yes! Here, let me give you this.|Kilton|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|This is proof you have defeated every last {{Color BotW|Blue|Molduga}} in Hyrule.|Kilton|BotW}}</ref> To obtain them, Link must defeat all 40 [[Hinox]]es and [[Stalnox]]es, all 40 [[Stone Talus|Talus]]es, and all four [[Molduga]]s. If Link has not defeated all of them, he can ask Kilton for the exact number of bosses slain so far.<ref>{{Cite|Let's see how many {{Color BotW|Blue|Stone Taluses}} you've harvested so far... Looks like [X] out of 40.|Kilton|BotW}}</ref> When fighting a boss that has already been defeated, the text "★ Defeated" will appear to the right of its health bar.
